activate_my_card.rationale: Activating a newly received card; a help article on activation covers it.

card_about_to_expire.rationale: Card expiry and replacement are card_services; the renewal process is standard.

card_acceptance.rationale: Where the card can be used; a help article on acceptance covers it.

card_arrival.rationale: Card ordered but not arrived; staff must check the specific order and delivery.

card_delivery_estimate.rationale: Generic delivery time question; answered by a help article.

card_linking.rationale: Adding an existing or new card to the app; a how-to article covers it.

card_not_working.rationale: A specific card failing needs a look at card status on the account.

change_pin.rationale: How to change a PIN; standard how-to.

contactless_not_working.rationale: Card feature not working; treated like card_not_working, needs a check of the card.

country_support.rationale: Which countries cards/app are available in; card_services per queue brief, but a manager could treat it as account eligibility (account_security).

declined_card_payment.rationale: Queue brief puts 'declined at a merchant' in card_services; payments_transfers (card payment status) is a reasonable alternative. Needs account investigation.

disposable_card_limits.rationale: How many disposable cards can be made; product rule in a help article.

get_disposable_virtual_card.rationale: How to get a disposable virtual card; standard how-to.

get_physical_card.rationale: In Banking77 these messages are about the PIN for a new physical card (where it is, how to set it); PIN is card_services.

getting_virtual_card.rationale: How to get a virtual card; standard how-to.

order_physical_card.rationale: How to order a physical card; standard how-to.

pin_blocked.rationale: Unblocking a PIN after wrong attempts; PIN is card_services and the unblock steps are a standard article.

virtual_card_not_working.rationale: A specific virtual card failing needs a check of the card on the account.

visa_or_mastercard.rationale: Which card network is issued/accepted; a help article covers it.

Refund_not_showing_up.rationale: A merchant refund that has not appeared; staff must trace the specific transaction.

beneficiary_not_allowed.rationale: Adding a beneficiary failed; needs a look at the account.

cancel_transfer.rationale: Cancelling a specific transfer usually needs staff action on that transfer.

declined_transfer.rationale: A specific transfer declined; needs investigation.

failed_transfer.rationale: A specific transfer failed; needs investigation.

pending_card_payment.rationale: Card payment status (pending) is explicitly payments_transfers in the queue brief; needs a look at the transaction.

pending_transfer.rationale: A specific transfer still pending; needs a look at the transfer.

receiving_money.rationale: How to receive money from others; a how-to article covers it.

request_refund.rationale: Customer wants a refund for a purchase; may need a dispute or chargeback raised by staff.

reverted_card_payment?.rationale: A card payment that was reverted; card payment status, needs a look at the transaction.

transaction_charged_twice.rationale: Duplicate card payment is card payment status (payments_transfers); fees_exchange (extra charge on statement) or account_security (unrecognised payment) are reasonable alternatives.

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.rationale: Recipient has not received a specific transfer; needs tracing.

transfer_timing.rationale: How long transfers take; a help article covers it.

apple_pay_or_google_pay.rationale: In Banking77 these messages are about topping up with Apple Pay / Google Pay; top_up_balance, but card_services (adding the card to a wallet) is a reasonable alternative.

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.rationale: Queue brief puts 'balance not updated after a deposit' in top_up_balance; payments_transfers (money received not showing) is a reasonable alternative. Needs tracing.

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.rationale: Cash/cheque deposit not credited; needs tracing.

pending_top_up.rationale: A specific top-up still pending; needs a look at the account.

supported_cards_and_currencies.rationale: In Banking77 these messages are mostly about which cards and currencies can be used to add money; top_up_balance, but fees_exchange (supported currencies) or card_services are reasonable alternatives.

top_up_by_cash_or_cheque.rationale: How to top up with cash or cheque; standard how-to.

top_up_failed.rationale: A specific top-up failed; needs investigation.

top_up_limits.rationale: Top-up limits are a product rule in a help article.

top_up_reverted.rationale: A specific top-up reversed; needs investigation.

topping_up_by_card.rationale: How to top up with a card; standard how-to.

transfer_into_account.rationale: Customer asks how to put money into their own account by bank transfer, which is a top-up; payments_transfers (receiving transfers) is a reasonable alternative.

verify_top_up.rationale: Why/how a top-up card must be verified; top_up_balance, but account_security (verification) is a reasonable alternative.

atm_support.rationale: Which ATMs accept the card; a help article covers it.

card_swallowed.rationale: ATM kept the card is cash_atm per queue brief; card_services (replacement card) is a reasonable alternative. Staff usually need to block/replace the card.

declined_cash_withdrawal.rationale: A specific withdrawal declined; needs investigation.

pending_cash_withdrawal.rationale: A specific withdrawal pending; needs a look at the transaction.

wrong_amount_of_cash_received.rationale: ATM dispensed the wrong amount; staff must investigate and possibly raise a claim.

card_payment_fee_charged.rationale: A fee on a card payment is a fee question (fees_exchange); payments_transfers is a reasonable alternative. The fee schedule article explains when it applies.

card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.rationale: Wrong exchange rate on a card payment; exchange rates are fees_exchange. Needs a look at the transaction.

cash_withdrawal_charge.rationale: A fee on a cash withdrawal is a fee question; cash_atm is a reasonable alternative. The fee schedule article explains it.

exchange_charge.rationale: Fees for currency exchange; covered by the fee schedule.

exchange_rate.rationale: Which exchange rate is used; a help article covers it.

exchange_via_app.rationale: How to exchange currency in the app; standard how-to.

extra_charge_on_statement.rationale: Queue brief puts unexpected extra charges in fees_exchange; account_security (unrecognised payment) is a reasonable alternative. Needs a look at the statement.

fiat_currency_support.rationale: Which currencies are supported; a help article covers it.

top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.rationale: Fee for topping up by bank transfer is a fee question; top_up_balance is a reasonable alternative. Fee schedule explains it.

top_up_by_card_charge.rationale: Fee for topping up by card is a fee question; top_up_balance is a reasonable alternative. Fee schedule explains it.

transfer_fee_charged.rationale: A fee on a transfer is a fee question; payments_transfers is a reasonable alternative. Fee schedule explains it.

wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.rationale: Wrong exchange rate on an ATM withdrawal; fees_exchange (exchange rates), but cash_atm (wrong amount from a withdrawal) is a reasonable alternative. Needs a look at the transaction.

age_limit.rationale: Minimum age requirement; queue brief puts age requirements here; a help article covers it.

card_payment_not_recognised.rationale: Unrecognised card payment is suspected fraud (account_security); payments_transfers is a reasonable alternative. Needs investigation.

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.rationale: Unrecognised cash withdrawal is suspected fraud (account_security); cash_atm is a reasonable alternative. Needs investigation.

compromised_card.rationale: Compromised card / suspected fraud; staff must block and investigate.

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.rationale: Unrecognised direct debit is suspected fraud (account_security); payments_transfers (direct debits) is a reasonable alternative. Needs investigation.

edit_personal_details.rationale: Updating name/address; queue brief puts personal details here; a how-to article covers it.

lost_or_stolen_card.rationale: Lost or stolen card is account_security per queue brief; card_services (replacement) is a reasonable alternative. Staff must block the card.

lost_or_stolen_phone.rationale: Lost or stolen phone with app access; staff must secure the account.

passcode_forgotten.rationale: Resetting a forgotten passcode; standard how-to.

terminate_account.rationale: Closing the account; queue brief puts closure here. Staff must act on the specific account (balance, pending items).

unable_to_verify_identity.rationale: Identity verification failing for this customer; staff must review.

verify_my_identity.rationale: How to verify identity; standard how-to.

verify_source_of_funds.rationale: How/why to verify source of funds; a help article covers it.

why_verify_identity.rationale: Why identity verification is needed; a help article covers it.
